entities.name: Caucasian Albania (Sasanian province)
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Caucasian Albania was a kingdom in West Asia in the Caucasus region, which was under the suzerainty of the Sasanian Empire from 252 to 636. Caucasian Albania should not be confused with European Albania. The toponym was created from Greek sources who incorrectly translated the Armenian language.
